summary: The Magma Rivers are the molten arteries of the Plane of Fire. Divine magma flows through colossal caverns, powering elemental furnaces and shaping the stone guardians of the realm.
history: The Magma Rivers were the first channels carved by the elemental flame.
Stone bridges were shaped from cooled divine magma.
Forge vents were created to regulate elemental heat.
The Magma Sovereign arose from the deepest molten core.
